_meta: Editable KP event rules. cusp = house whose sub-lord judges the event; primary = house a running dasha lord should signify; support/denial = house groups. any_support = a house group where any one match is enough (used for income and degree). alt_support = a variant group printed in the Readers, kept for reference but not used by the promise check. status: verified = confirmed in the uploaded Readers (line refs are to the OCR txt files); partial = part verified; unverified = common teaching, not yet found in the Readers. Never change a verified group without a Reader reference. depends_on lists parent event keys: it is a soft gate, so a child window is only flagged (never dropped) when it falls inside a parent event's window; citation in depends_on_source.

marriage.source: Reader 4 ~l.7128-7139 (order of judging: 2,7,11) and l.7160-7168: sub-lord of a significator connected with 2,7,11 is useful; if the sub is lord of 1,6,10 and significator of 12, marriage cannot take place; ruling planets at the moment of judgement must agree.
marriage.plain: Marriage is judged from the 7th house. Houses 2 (family), 7 (partner) and 11 (wish fulfilled) say 'yes'. Houses 1, 6, 10 and 12 say 'no' or 'trouble'. It happens in a period whose planets link to 2, 7 and 11.

childbirth.source: Reader 3 ~l.25783-25789: sub-lord of 5th cusp as significator of 2/5/11 -> child; as significator of 1/4/10 -> never a child; 1,4,10 are the 12th (negation) to 2,5,11. Reader 4 ~l.12824-12853: judge 2,5,11 and the strength of Jupiter; 11th cusp sub-lord for a male child, 5th for a female.
childbirth.plain: A child is judged from the 5th house. Houses 2, 5 and 11 promise a child; houses 1, 4 and 10 (the opposite side) refuse it. Jupiter's strength matters too, and the 11th shows a boy while the 5th shows a girl.
childbirth.depends_on_source: Reader 6 ~l.16491-16496: a promised event is experienced only in the dasa-bhukti of its significators; the worked example is child birth not occurring for 10 years after marriage. Reader 4 ~l.12805-12806: the horoscopes of both husband and wife are judged for progeny; l.12827-12829: the 11th house is 'also the 5th house to the 7th partner', linking progeny to the 7th (marriage).

job.source: Reader 3 ~l.11964-11965: houses 2,6,10 indicate service; the 12th from these (1,5,9) show end of service or retirement. 11 added for gain: Reader 3 ~l.12938 (income/debt cleared through 2,6,10,11).
job.plain: A job is judged from the 10th house. Houses 2 (income), 6 (service), 10 (profession) and 11 (gain) support it. Houses 1, 5 and 9 point towards leaving or ending a job.

first_job.source: Reader 3 ~l.11964-11965: houses 2,6,10 indicate service; the 12th from these (1,5,9) show end of service. Reader 6 ~l.18260-18262: 'To enter into service: the sub-lord of the sixth is to be deposited in the constellation of the planet signifying houses 10 and 11.' Reader 3 ~l.22345-22352: 2 receipt of money, 6 dues from service, 10 profession, 11 gain. The first job uses the same service promise (10th CSL) as job; its earliest matching dasha window is the first job.
first_job.plain: The first job is judged like service: the 10th cusp sub-lord must link to 2 (income), 6 (service), 10 (profession) or 11 (gain), and not to 1, 5 or 9 (ending). The first matching period is the first job and the start of regular income.

first_government_job.source: KP-E-Zine (Jan2015-Oct2020) 'Getting a government job through SSC CGL 2018 exam quota?' ~l.727284-727310: if the 10th CSL signifies 2, 6, 10 or 11 and/or is connected with the Sun or Moon, without the 8th, a government job is promised; time it by the joint period of the significators of 2, 6, 10 or 11. KP-E-Zine (Nov2020-Dec2021) 'Government Job Part 1' ~l.95631-95695: 11th/6th/10th CSL as significator of 2/6/10/11; 5 or 9 makes a job temporary. The engine checks the house group; the Sun/Moon condition is stated in the plain rule but not separately gated.
first_government_job.plain: A government job is judged from the 10th house. Its sub-lord must link to 2 (money), 6 (service), 10 (profession) or 11 (success), with no link to 8 (obstacles); the Sun or Moon as royal planets strengthens it. The joint period of those significators gives the job.

banking_job.source: KP-E-Zine (Jan2015-Oct2020) 'Bank Employees and KP' ~l.156435-156516: the 2nd house shows a career in banking, investments and finance; the 6th is service, the 8th is the bank's/customers' money, the 10th is career and the 11th is gain. Jupiter denotes bankers, Mercury bank-related jobs; banking signs are Taurus, Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius and Pisces. The worked charts time the job through 2/6/10/11 (l.157606-157647). The 8th is kept as alt_support because the article says it should especially be considered but does not make it a pass/fail gate.
banking_job.plain: A banking job is judged from the 2nd house (banking and finance), with 6 (service), 10 (career) and 11 (gain); the 8th (the bank's money) should also be examined. Jupiter and Mercury, and the banking signs Taurus, Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius and Pisces, are the trade signatures. Houses 1, 5 and 9 show the income or service ending.
banking_job.depends_on_source: A banking job is still service: Reader 3 ~l.11964-11965 (2, 6, 10 = service).

first_private_job.source: KP-E-Zine (Nov2020-Dec2021) 'Government Job Part 1' ~l.95679-95681: 'If the 10th Sublord is significator of 6 house through Starlord and 7th house through Sublord it indicates private job. Venus is planet for private job as well as for business.'
first_private_job.plain: A private job is shown when the 10th cusp sub-lord links 6 (service) and 7 (private employment/others); Venus strengthens it. The first matching period is the first private job.
first_private_job.depends_on_source: A private job is a job: Reader 3 ~l.11964-11965 (2, 6, 10 = service).

retirement.source: Reader 3 ~l.11961-11965: houses 2,6,10 indicate service, so the 12th to them i.e. 1,5,9 show end of service or retirement.
retirement.plain: Retirement is the reverse of service. Since 2, 6 and 10 mean being in service, houses 1, 5 and 9 (the opposite side) mean the job ends. It only makes sense after a job has begun.
retirement.depends_on_source: KP-E-Zine (Nov 2020-Dec 2021) ~l.125368-125369: 'KP Rule for Retirement: it happens during the joint dasa period of significators of 3, 5, 9 or 12 houses. To be in service are houses 2, 6, 10 or 11.' Retirement is the termination of a service that must first exist (Reader 3 ~l.11961-11965).

higher_education.source: Reader 3 ~l.16004-16028: education is successful if the lord of 4 and the lord of 9 are in the sub of a significator of 11; education ends during the periods of planets connected with 3, 5 or 8. Regular college studies: judge 4 and 11 (l.19158-19160).
higher_education.plain: Study goes well when the lords of the 4th (school) and 9th (higher learning) are tied to the 11th (success). Studies end in periods linked to houses 3, 5 or 8.

study_abroad.source: Reader 3 ~l.19020-19030: higher studies = 9th; stay in a foreign country = 12th (for job 6 and 10); scholarship = 6 and 11. Reader 3 ~l.19158-19166: leaving one's native place, hostel abroad, research/thesis -> judge 9 and 12, and to succeed the 11th significator should also signify 9 or 12 or both. Denial group [3,5,8] is inferred from the education-end rule, not stated for overseas study.
study_abroad.plain: Higher study is the 9th house and living in a foreign land is the 12th. To succeed, the 11th should also touch 9 or 12. This one is only partly confirmed in the books.
study_abroad.depends_on_source: Reader 3 ~l.19020-19030: higher studies is indicated by the 9th house; stay in a foreign country by the 12th. Reader 3 ~l.19158-19166: leaving one's native place / hostel abroad / research-thesis -> judge 9 and 12. Overseas study is the foreign (12th) branch of higher study (9th), so higher_education is its parent.

bachelor_degree.source: Jyotish Astro Secrets & KP Part5 ~l.3786-3843: graduate education is judged from the 4th house and its sub-lord; 4th CSL signifying 11 with 6 gives a competitive result; connected to 8 with 2/7/10/11 completes with obstacles; only 3 and 12 deny completion; 3 with 10 or 11 gives hostel study and completion; 3/9/12 without 4 or 10 gives a correspondence degree. The bachelor course table is at ~l.4026-4052. The engine accepts any of 4/9/11 because the article treats 4 as the base, 9 as higher study and 11 as success, while the 3/12 denial is conditional and cannot be encoded as a flat denial group.
bachelor_degree.plain: A bachelor's degree is judged from the 4th cusp and its sub-lord. A link to 4 (college), 9 (higher study) or 11 (success) carries the degree; 11 with 6 gives a competitive result. Only 3 and 12 together deny completion, while 3 with 10 or 11 can still complete through hostel study.

master_degree.source: Jyotish Astro Secrets & KP Part5 ~l.4474-4504: the 9th house denotes higher education and vocational training; 9th cusp sub-lord connected to 4, 9, 10 or 6 gives vocational training; 9 connected to 4 gives a regular post-graduate course; 9 connected to 3 gives post-graduation by correspondence. The engine uses 4/9/11 as the post-graduate group (college, higher study, success); the 3/6/10 variants are stated in the plain rule but not separately gated.
master_degree.plain: A master's degree is judged from the 9th cusp and its sub-lord. A link to 4 (regular college), 9 (higher study) or 11 (success) carries post-graduation; 9 with 4 is the regular PG route, while 3 with 9 is the correspondence route. The 9th also covers vocational and diploma courses.

foreign_travel.source: KP-E-Zine (Jul 2009) 'Rules for Foreign Going, Settlement and Return to Motherland' ~l.226664-226682: going abroad = houses 3 (away from home), 9 (long journey) and 12 (foreign stay); return/stay home = 2,8,11 (12th to 3,9,12), and 4 (motherland) may not allow settlement abroad. KP-E-Zine (Jan 2011) ~l.224031-224037: if the 12th cusp sub-lord signifies 3, 9 or 12, foreign travel is promised in the joint period of the significators of 3,9,12. Also Reader 3 ~l.3311: Mercury owning 9 and 12 indicates overseas.
foreign_travel.plain: Going abroad is judged from the 12th house. House 3 is leaving home, 9 is a long journey, 12 is a stay in another land. Houses 2, 4, 8 and 11 pull you back home.

property_purchase.source: Reader 3 ~l.14533-14551: purchase -> judge 4 (land/building), 11 (gain/acquisition) and 12 (payment, the cheque issued). Reader 3 ~l.14651-14654: the later research (after 1967) states acquisition = 2,4,11; disposal = 3,5,10. Both variants are in the book; support here is the chapter form 4,11,12 with 2,4,11 kept as alt_support.
property_purchase.plain: Buying property is judged from the 4th house (land, building). House 11 is the gain and 12 is the payment going out. Houses 3, 5 and 10 point to selling instead.

property_sale.source: Reader 3 ~l.14643-14654: disposal of a house is judged from the 3rd, 5th and 10th bhavas; acquisition (2,4,11) is the opposite group. 3rd is vyaya (loss) to the 4th (permanent possession).
property_sale.plain: Selling a house is judged from the 3rd, 5th and 10th houses. Houses 2, 4 and 11 are the opposite (buying and keeping).
property_sale.depends_on_source: Reader 3 ~l.14651-14654: 'Acquisition of a house: Judge the second, fourth and eleventh bhavas. Disposal of a house: 3rd, 5th and 10th bhavas.' Disposal presupposes an earlier acquisition; the two are the opposite house groups.

engagement.source: Reader 3 ~l.25463-25470: 2,7,11 give marriage; if also 3 (own agreement) and 9 (other party's consent) the marriage is engaged. Denial from R4 ~l.7160.
engagement.plain: Houses 2, 7 and 11 give marriage. When 3 (your own agreement) and 9 (the other side's consent) join them, it shows the engagement stage.

separation.source: Reader 4 ~l.8972-8985: separation from partner judged from 1,6,10,12; ~l.4205-4212: if the same planet also signifies 2,7,11 the quarrel is brief and they reunite.
separation.plain: Separation from a partner is seen from houses 1, 6, 10 and 12. If the same planet also touches 2, 7 and 11, the quarrel is short and the couple comes together again.

divorce.source: Reader 4 ~l.9477: divorce is seen from houses 1, 6 and 10 (6 is 12th from 7); Mars/Jupiter-in-Mars-star adds litigation (~l.9480-9490).
divorce.plain: Divorce is seen from houses 1, 6 and 10 (the 6th is the 12th house from the 7th, meaning loss of partner). Court cases are hinted by Mars, or Jupiter in a Mars star.

second_marriage.source: Reader 4 ~l.9010-9015, 5108: 2nd cusp is second marriage; sub-lord connected with 7 -> second marriage, with 11 -> only a live-in attachment. Plurality: 7th cusp sub-lord in a dual sign (~l.8905). Denial group borrowed from marriage.
second_marriage.plain: The 2nd house shows a second marriage. If its sub-lord links to 7 it is a marriage; if it links to 11 it is only a live-in bond. This one is only partly confirmed.

partnership_new.source: Reader 3 ~l.25622-25630: new partner when significator of 7 also signifies 11, and 11 connects with 2 or 10.
partnership_new.plain: A new partner comes when the planet of house 7 also touches 11, and 11 links with 2 or 10.

partnership_end.source: Reader 3 ~l.25604-25621: significator of 7 also of 6 -> partner leaves; also of 12 -> you sever the connection.
partnership_end.plain: A partner leaves when the planet of house 7 also touches house 6. If it touches 12, you end the connection yourself.

first_salary.source: Reader 3 ~l.22345-22420: 2 receipt of money, 6 dues from service, 10 profession, 11 gain; 12th from these (1,5,9) end of income. This is the first salary/first-income rule; a separate income window is not promised when the 2nd CSL also links 1 or 5.
first_salary.plain: First salary or first income is judged from the 2nd house. Money received is 2, service dues are 6, profession is 10, and gain is 11; houses 1, 5 and 9 point to income ending.

regular_income.source: KP-E-Zine (Jan2015-Oct2020) Feb 2017 ~l.315600-315608 and (Jan2011-Dec2014) Feb 2019 ~l.542323-542334: 'If the 2nd cusp sublord signifies 2 (income) or 6 (service) or 7 (business) or 10 (profession) or 11 (fulfillment of desire), then the income is promised to the native.' The Readers do not fix a rupee amount. For level, KP-E-Zine (Jan2011-Dec2014) ~l.285084-285087 reads 12/1/9 together with 2/11 as low income and no stability, while a clean 2/11 gives steady income.
regular_income.plain: Regular income is promised when the 2nd cusp sub-lord links any of 2 (income), 6 (service), 7 (business), 10 (profession) or 11 (gain). The Readers do not fix a rupee amount: a clean 2/11 with strong 2nd/11th lords shows steady or high income, while 1/5/9/12 show leakage, low or unsteady income.

reinstatement.source: Reader 3 ~l.22569-22640: judge 2,6,10,11; suspension is shown by 5,9,12 (l.22517).
reinstatement.plain: Getting a job back is judged from houses 2, 6, 10 and 11. Houses 5, 9 and 12 show suspension, the opposite.

suspension.source: Reader 3 ~l.22517 and l.25510-25518: 5,9 with 12 -> suspension; 10 with 12 -> inquiry/exposure.
suspension.plain: Suspension from work is shown by 5 and 9 together with 12. House 10 with 12 shows an inquiry or exposure.

termination_of_service.source: Reader 3 ~l.23140-23145: termination judged from 1,5,9 and 12 (1 negates 2).
termination_of_service.plain: Losing a job is judged from 1, 5, 9 and 12. House 1 cancels house 2 (income).

transfer.source: Reader 3 ~l.22861-22870: for transfer consider 3, 9 and 12 (for a spouse count them from the 7th).
transfer.plain: A transfer is judged from houses 3, 9 and 12. For a spouse's transfer, count the same houses from the 7th.

deputation_with_gain.source: Reader 3 ~l.25471-25478: houses 5, 9, 11 judged; the 11th significator should also signify 12 (service in a new place).
deputation_with_gain.plain: A posting elsewhere with benefit is judged from 5, 9 and 11. The 11th should also touch 12 (work in a new place).

selection_for_post.source: Reader 3 ~l.25479-25490: news of selection when significator of 11 also signifies 3; actual promotion in the combined period of 2/6/10 and 11.
selection_for_post.plain: News of selection comes when the planet of house 11 also touches 3. A real promotion needs the joint period of 2, 6, 10 and 11.

loan_borrowing.source: Reader 3 ~l.13157-13160, 9063: conjoined period of significators of 2 and 6 -> borrowing; sub of 8 or 12 -> repaying or lending.
loan_borrowing.plain: Borrowing money happens in a period joining houses 2 and 6. Houses 8 or 12 show repaying or lending instead.

loan_repayment.source: Reader 3 ~l.25730-25738: significators of 8 and 12 show repayment or lending; discharge of a loan is judged from 12 (l.13175).
loan_repayment.plain: Houses 8 and 12 show repaying or lending. Clearing a loan fully is judged from the 12th.

windfall_gain.source: Reader 3 ~l.25735-25738: significator of 8 also of 6 and 11 -> money received; of 8 and 12 -> you pay out.
windfall_gain.plain: Sudden money comes when the planet of house 8 also touches 6 and 11. If it touches 8 and 12 you pay out instead.

speculation_gain.source: Reader 3 ~l.25776-25781: 5 gives the opportunity, with 6 and 11 you gain, with 8 and 12 you lose. Reader 6 ~l.15419-15420: '2, 5, 6 and 11 to gain in speculation.'
speculation_gain.plain: House 5 gives the chance to speculate. With 6 and 11 you gain; with 8 and 12 you lose. Reader 6 adds house 2 (money) to the gain group.

imprisonment.source: Reader 3 ~l.25740-25750 and l.24615-24640: 3, 8, 12 for imprisonment; confinement in one's own house 4, 8, 12.
imprisonment.plain: Confinement is shown by houses 3, 8 and 12. Being confined at home is shown by 4, 8 and 12.

accident_on_journey.source: Reader 3 ~l.25632-25640: significator of 3 (short) or 9 (long journey) that also signifies 6 and 8 -> accident; also 12 -> hospitalisation.
accident_on_journey.plain: A journey is house 3 (short) or 9 (long). If that planet also touches 6 and 8 there is a risk of accident; with 12 as well, hospital stay.

phd_thesis.source: Reader 3 ~l.25752-25760: thesis in combined period of 4 and 9; 9 also signifying 11 -> doctorate; 9 with 12 -> failure.
phd_thesis.plain: A thesis runs in the joint period of houses 4 and 9. If 9 also touches 11 you earn the doctorate; 9 with 12 shows failure.

vehicle_purchase.source: Reader 3 ~l.14946: conveyance is the 4th house; 4, 9, 10 and 11 are examined. Reader 6 ~l.15432: '2, 4, 11 for car' (kept as alt_support).
vehicle_purchase.plain: A vehicle is the 4th house. Houses 4, 9, 10 and 11 are checked together; Reader 6 also gives 2, 4 and 11 for a car.

tenant_arrival.source: Reader 3 ~l.25653-25660: tenant is the 6th; significators of 6, 9 and 4 (4th from 6 = 9th) together bring a tenant; 8th (3rd from 6) takes him away.
tenant_arrival.plain: A tenant is the 6th house. Houses 6, 9 and 4 together bring one; house 8 takes him away.

tenant_vacate.source: Reader 3 ~l.25641-25652: tenant leaves in the combined period of significators of 6 and 8.
tenant_vacate.plain: A tenant leaves in the joint period of houses 6 and 8.

illness.source: Reader 3 ~l.9864-9868: disease is indicated by the 6th cusp, 6th house, planets in the constellation of its occupants/lord, operating in dasa-bhukti-antara. Reader 3 ~l.17665: 'Disease is indicated by the sixth house; 8th the danger, 12th the defect.' Cure houses 1,5,11 are the denial: Reader 3 ~l.10818-10822 (11th cures disease, being the 6th to the 6th) and KP-E-Zine (Jan2015-Oct2020) ~l.154147, 699160, 752258 (1,5,11 = cure/recovery).
illness.plain: Disease is shown by the 6th house; the 8th is the danger and the 12th the weakness. Houses 1, 5 and 11 mean cure, the opposite.

recovery_from_illness.source: KP-E-Zine (Jan2015-Oct2020) ~l.699160: if the 1st cusp sub-lord through its star lord signifies 1,5,11, cure from the disease; ~l.752258: 1,5,11 cure diseases/recovery, 'if connected with 6, 12 no cure'; ~l.154147: ascendant CSL links with 1,5,11 = cure and release from hospital. KP-E-Zine (Feb2007-Dec2010) ~l.61178 same table. Reader 3 ~l.8715-8719: sub-lord of the ascendant signifying 1 and 11 promises cure and speedy recovery.
recovery_from_illness.plain: Recovery is shown when the 1st house link goes through 1, 5 and 11. If it is mixed with 6 and 12, there is no cure yet.
recovery_from_illness.depends_on_source: Reader 3 ~l.10818-10822: planets connected with the 11th house cure the disease 'as the eleventh house is the 6th to the 6th'; recovery presupposes the disease indicated by 6,8,12 (Reader 3 ~l.17665).

promotion.source: KP-E-Zine (May 2015) 'Promotion in service - KP rules' ~l.49810-49826: the 10th is the primary house; if the 10th cusp sub-lord signifies 2, 6, 10 or 11 one is surely promoted, and the timing is the conjoined period of the significators of those houses. KP-E-Zine (Feb 2007-Dec 2010) ~l.78933-78940: same rule; a retrograde sub-lord delays promotion. Reader 6 ~l.15428: '2, 6, 10, 11 for promotion.'
promotion.plain: Promotion is judged from the 10th house. When its sub-lord links to 2 (income), 6 (service), 10 (position) and 11 (gain), promotion is promised; it happens in a joint period of those planets.
promotion.depends_on_source: A promotion presupposes service: Reader 3 ~l.11961-11965 (houses 2, 6 and 10 indicate service); Reader 6 ~l.15428-15438 lists service and promotion in the same table.

leaving_job.source: KP-E-Zine (Feb 2007-Dec 2010) ~l.124818-124823: 'If the Sub-lord of the 10th or 6th cusp be the significator of 1, 3, 5 or 9, the querent can leave present service.' Houses 1, 5 and 9 are the 12th (negation) to the service houses 2, 6 and 10; house 3 is change.
leaving_job.plain: Leaving a job is shown when the 10th or 6th cusp sub-lord links to 1, 3, 5 or 9. House 3 is change, 9 is a long move, and 1 and 5 are the opposite side of income and service.
leaving_job.depends_on_source: Leaving service presupposes service: Reader 3 ~l.11961-11965 (2, 6, 10 = service); the rule itself is stated for the 10th or 6th cusp, the houses of a job (KP-E-Zine Feb 2007-Dec 2010 ~l.124818-124823).

foreign_job.source: KP-E-Zine (Feb 2007-Dec 2010) ~l.124830-124833: 'If the 12th cuspal sub-lord signifies 3, 9 or 12, preferably 9, along with 6 or 10 one can go abroad for job.' Houses 6 and 10 are kept as alt_support because they are required in addition, not as part of the foreign group. Reader 6 ~l.14856: for overseas judge 3, 9 and 12.
foreign_job.plain: A foreign job needs the 12th cusp sub-lord to touch 3 (leaving home), 9 (long journey) or 12 (foreign stay), preferably 9, and also to touch 6 (service) or 10 (profession).
foreign_job.depends_on_source: A foreign job is still a job: Reader 3 ~l.11961-11965 (2, 6, 10 = service) and Reader 6 ~l.14856 (3, 9, 12 = overseas).

business_start.source: KP-E-Zine (May 2015) 'Can I have a press of my own' ~l.70504-70509: 'If the cuspal sub lord of the 10th be the significator of house 2, 7 or 10, an independent [business is promised]'; the article then checks the 7th cusp for gain. Reader 6 ~l.15430: 2, 4, 11 for house.
business_start.plain: Starting one's own business is judged from the 10th cusp. If its sub-lord links to 2 (money), 7 (trade/partner) or 10 (profession), independent business is promised.

business_gain.source: KP-E-Zine (May 2015) ~l.71070-71076: 'If the cuspal sub lord of the 7th be the significator of house 2, 10 or 11, gain in business is promised during the joint period of the significators of house 2, 10 and 11.'
business_gain.plain: Profit in business is judged from the 7th cusp (trade and the other party). If its sub-lord links to 2 (income), 10 (business) and 11 (gain), profit is promised in a joint period of those planets.
business_gain.depends_on_source: Gain in business presupposes a business: the same article first judges starting it from the 10th cusp (KP-E-Zine May 2015 ~l.70504-70509) and then its gain from the 7th cusp (~l.71070-71076).

love_affair.source: KP-E-Zine (Jan 2015-Oct 2020) ~l.68428-68431: 'If the 5 cusp sub lord is in the constellation of a planet who is the significator of the houses 7 and 11, then the materialization of love affair is promised.' Reader 4 ~l.6404-6405: the 5th shows love affair or children, the 4th failure in love affairs.
love_affair.plain: A love affair is judged from the 5th house. When its sub-lord is tied to 7 (the partner) and 11 (fulfilment), the affair materialises; the 4th house shows failure in love.

college_admission.source: KP-E-Zine (Jan 2015-Oct 2020) 'Rule for admission in desired college' ~l.141537-141545: for success in a competitive examination the 4th cusp should signify 4, 9 and 11, and success comes in the DBA of 4, 9 and 11; Mercury and Jupiter are the deciding planets. Education-end group 3, 5, 8 from Reader 3 ~l.16004-16028.
college_admission.plain: Admission to a college is judged from the 4th cusp with 9 (higher study) and 11 (success). Houses 3, 5 and 8 show studies ending or being interrupted.

visa_papers.source: KP-E-Zine (Jan 2015-Oct 2020) 'Rule for Visa Papers' ~l.55633-55640: if the 3rd sub-lord signifies 3 and 11 the desired result comes; if the 11th cusp sub-lord signifies 3 or 11 it is positive; the 3rd and 11th cusps should link to 3, 9 or 12 for a foreign visa.
visa_papers.plain: Visa papers, letters and tickets are the 3rd house. Success needs 3 (documents and communication) and 11 (fulfilment); a foreign visa also needs a link to 9 (long journey) or 12 (foreign stay).

cinema_actor.source: KP-E-Zine (Feb 2007-Dec 2010) 'KP Rule for Cinema Actors' ~l.173169-173175: the 5th cuspal sub-lord should signify 5, 7, 10 and 11 and be connected with Venus/Mercury; the 10th cuspal sub-lord should signify 5, 7 and 10 for cinema as the main profession.
cinema_actor.plain: Cinema and acting are judged from the 5th house (entertainment). Its sub-lord should link to 5 (talent), 7 (art), 10 (profession) and 11 (success), with Venus or Mercury involved.

sports_victory.source: KP-E-Zine (Jan 2015-Oct 2020) 'New rules for sport competition' ~l.71299-71307: the 1st, 6th and 11th cusp sub-lords must signify 1, 6 or 11; 6 is stronger than 1 and 11, and 11 is stronger than 1, so the 6th cusp sub-lord must signify 6 more than 1 or 11.
sports_victory.plain: Winning a competition is judged from the 1st (self), 6th (contest) and 11th (victory) cusps. Their sub-lords should link to 1, 6 or 11; the 6th link is the strongest sign of winning.

election_win.source: KP-E-Zine (Feb 2007-Dec 2010) ~l.175644-175646: 'If the Asc. Sublord signifies 6 + 11, then the native wins; but if it signifies 5 + 12, then he loses and the opponent wins.' Reader 6 ~l.15448: 6, 11 to be successful in election.
election_win.plain: In an election the 1st cusp is the candidate. If its sub-lord links to 6 (contest) and 11 (victory) the candidate wins; a link to 5 and 12 means defeat.

litigation_win.source: Reader 6 ~l.15442-15443: '6, 11 to win the litigation.' The 6th is the house of dispute and the opponent, the 11th is success; Reader 6 ~l.13189-13192 uses the same success group for recovering lost property.
litigation_win.plain: A court case is judged from the 6th house (dispute). Houses 6 and 11 together show winning; the 11th is success and fulfilment.

lost_property_recovery.source: Reader 6 'Theft and Recovery' ~l.13145-13205: property lost is judged by houses 2, 6 and 11 counted from the house of the person who lost it; if the significators of 2, 6 and 11 agree with the ruling planets the property is recovered, but if the ruling planets are connected with 5, 8 and 12 it is lost for good. The Reader gives no cusp; the 11th (recovery/fulfilment) is used for the promise check.
lost_property_recovery.plain: Recovery of stolen or lost property is judged from 2 (property), 6 (loss/dispute) and 11 (recovery). A link to 5, 8 or 12 means it is gone for good.

return_from_abroad.source: Reader 4 ~l.12640-12651: 'Return from the foreign land means leaving his present place, making a long journey and reuniting with his kith and kin... Leaving the place... is to be judged from the 3rd house, making a long journey... from the 9th house. Reunion with kith and kin is found from the 11th house. Therefore one has to judge the houses 3, 9 and 11.'
return_from_abroad.plain: Returning from abroad is the reverse journey: 3 (leaving the present place), 9 (the long journey) and 11 (reunion with family). Those three houses show the return.
return_from_abroad.depends_on_source: A return presupposes a stay abroad: KP-E-Zine (Jul 2009) ~l.226664-226682 (going abroad = 3, 9, 12) and Reader 4 ~l.12640-12651 (return = 3, 9, 11).

pet_animal.plain: A pet animal is judged from 6 (small animals and companions) and 11 (getting the wish).
